title: Customer compliance evidence runbooks and automated export flows
creator: Ava Patel
description: Provide customers with prescriptive evidence runbooks and a one-click export engine that bundles tenancy-specific artifacts (DPA excerpts, data residency assertions, retention configuration snapshots, access logs, and eval reports) into audit-ready packages. Focus on SaaS-hosted and Dedicated modes first, with a path to Private/VPC. Goal: reduce manual security/compliance requests and accelerate SOC / customer audit cycles.
background: Enterprise prospects frequently ask for tailored evidence for vendor assessments and audits. Current process is manual: SEs and Legal compile documents, escalate to infra for logs, and engineering produces ad-hoc exports. This is slow, error-prone, and blocks sales and renewals. Similar tickets (PM-4132, PM-4287) covered questionnaire templates and DPA centric tooling but did not implement automated, tenant-scoped export runbooks or retention/residency snapshots for audit packaging.
scope: In scope: UI in Console for 'Create Evidence Package', backend export API, standardized templates for common questionnaires (SIG, ISO27001, SOC2), automated inclusion of: DPA clause references, tenant region assertion, last N months of access logs, retention policy snapshots, encryption KMS key IDs, IAM role mappings, and links to previous evals and monitor dashboards. Support export formats: ZIP with structured metadata.json and PDF summary. Out of scope: legal review automation and attestation signatures.
out_of_scope: No automated legal signature or contract negotiation. No live notarization service. On-prem agent for air-gapped environments deferred to Private deployment backlog.
acceptance_criteria: Console UX: Admins can request an evidence package for a given workspace and time window and see progress status (Queued / Bundling / Ready / Failed)
Backend: Export API returns a signed (HMAC) manifest and a pre-signed download URL valid for 24 hours

Contents: Package contains metadata.json listing included artifacts, DPA references (redwood-dpa-v1.pdf), retention-policy-snapshot.json, residency-assertion.txt, and access_logs.csv covering requested window
Security: Export respects RBAC - only workspace admins or accounts with 'compliance:export' can generate packages
Performance: Typical package generation for 30-day request in Hosted mode completes within 10 minutes for workspaces with <= 5M tokens/month
QA: E2E tests that validate content integrity and manifest signatures are added to CI
success_metrics: Reduce mean time to deliver compliance evidence from 5 business days to < 4 hours for standard packages
Decrease number of manual SE/Eng interventions per customer request by 80%
Increase conversion rate for enterprise trial accounts that submit compliance requests by 15% within 90 days
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Beta): Console toggle for 'Generate Evidence Package' for Hosted workspaces — invite-only customers and internal legal to validate (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Support Dedicated workspaces and include retention-policy snapshots and KMS key IDs (3 weeks)
Phase 3: Add questionnaire mapping (SIG + SOC2) and template overrides; publish Confluence runbooks for SEs (2 weeks)
Phase 4: Harden access logs export performance, add paginated background bundling for large customers, and add monitoring/alerting for failed bundles (2 weeks)
Communications: Release notes, SE playbook, legal onboarding session, and a small technical webinar
dependencies: ENG-5874 (export job queue and worker autoscaling)
